title: Runtime Proxy Traps vs Compiled Updates
description: Compare how a runtime Proxy intercepts writes at execution time vs how a compiler emits direct updates.

steps.label: 1. Runtime: Wrap & Intercept [[Get]]
steps.description: Reading state.count inside an effect invokes the Proxy get trap and records a dependency.
steps.codeHighlight: get(target, key) { track(target, key); return Reflect.get(target, key); }

steps.label: 2. Runtime: [[Set]] Trap Broadcast
steps.description: Assigning state.count++ triggers the set trap, checks Object.is, and queues the effect.
steps.codeHighlight: set(target, key, val) { trigger(target, key); return true; }

steps.label: 3. Compiler: Direct Signal Mutation
steps.description: Build-time AST transform rewrites count++ into $.set(count, v + 1) with zero Proxy wrappers.
